etymology.historical_story: For the English place name, Chester preserves a connection with Britain's Roman military landscape. The local visitor authority links names containing chester, cester, or caster with Roman forts and identifies Chester with the fortress of Deva. This background concerns the English city name; it does not establish that the supplied lowercase token is an official Malay lexical item. [Visit Chester & Cheshire: Roman Chester Trail](https://visitcheshire.com/directory/roman-chester-trail)
